name: Clicks Group Limited
source: Clicks Group Limited audited annual results for the year ended 31 August 2026, consolidated statement of financial position (annual results announcement and analyst booklet, October 2026), printed in R thousands and stored here as absolute ZAR. Every FY2026 figure is printed: non-current assets 9,165,878, current assets 14,960,074, cash and cash equivalents 2,301,427, total assets 24,125,952, non-current liabilities 3,234,523, current liabilities 14,085,821, total equity 6,805,608. Total liabilities 17,320,344 is the printed non-current and current liabilities added, which is the figure that makes total assets equal total liabilities plus total equity. The FY2025 comparatives printed alongside agree with the values already stored.
